frame: the existing WMAP Galactic contact frame, with no frame fit
prefilter: as in WMAP audit: nested arithmetic means to NSIDE 128, equal-weight full-sky quadrature for ell=2 and ell=3
latitude_fit_control: same WMAP abs(b)>=20 degree support and joint ell 0..8 fit at NSIDE 64, retain ell 2 and 3
beams: published map beams, no new beam correction or gain normalization
common_geometry: same native projectors, decoder at rcond 1e-10 and 8192 fixed Fibonacci evaluation points, applied separately to each mission
comparisons: sky, degree 2, degree 3, all directional samples and native register; mission-to-mission receivers and predictions on the same held-out grid
source_column_amendment: The noSZ I_STOKES_INP temperature payload failed its published K_CMB scale. Use the standard I_STOKES column across both Planck products. This selection preceded any receiver comparison and all observation and scoring parameters remain sealed.
